content: SwiftShader's src/Vulkan/CMakeLists.txt defines add_library(vk_swiftshader SHARED ...) unconditionally (not gated behind any option) as part of the always-run add_subdirectory(src/Vulkan) in the root CMakeLists. Post-build custom command copies the built lib to ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME}/ and ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/. configure_file('vk_swiftshader_icd.json.tmpl' -> ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME}/vk_swiftshader_icd.json) generates the ICD manifest at CMake CONFIGURE time (not build time), pointing to a relative path like './libvk_swiftshader.so' or '.\vk_swiftshader.dll' so lib+manifest must stay side by side. SwiftShader's root CMakeLists has NO install() rules at all -- no CMake package config, in-tree-only consumption model. To scope the build to only vk_swiftshader: set SWIFTSHADER_BUILD_TESTS=OFF, SWIFTSHADER_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=OFF, SWIFTSHADER_BUILD_PVR=FALSE, BUILD_VULKAN_WRAPPER=OFF (skips googletest/benchmark/PowerVR_Examples/glslang submodules entirely) and explicitly target vk_swiftshader in the BUILD_COMMAND (cmake --build <dir> --target vk_swiftshader) rather than the default all-target build. REACTOR_BACKEND defaults to 'LLVM' using a PREBUILT LLVM 16.0 tree committed directly in the SwiftShader repo (third_party/llvm-16.0 is NOT a git submodule per .gitmodules -- it ships as regular repo content), so the default backend avoids compiling LLVM from source and avoids the heavy llvm-project submodule (only needed for the 'LLVM-Submodule' REACTOR_BACKEND alternative).
